name: Exterminatus
oracle_text:
Nonland permanents your opponents control lose indestructible until end of turn.
Destroy all nonland permanents.
blocked_sentences: Nonland permanents your opponents control lose indestructible until end of turn.

needs.what: a one-shot effect op for a bare "<objects> lose <keyword> until end of turn": a layer-6 keyword removal (613.7, timestamped) written as an until-end-of-turn entry on each object found as it resolves (611.2c), which a later grant of the same keyword overrides -- the effect-side twin of the `lose_keyword_timestamped` static
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `lose_keyword` op implements only the "lose X and can't have X" prohibition (the loader requires cant_have: true, and its docstring says reading a bare loss as the prohibition makes the card stronger); `lose_keyword_timestamped` is a static only, lasting while a source permanent stays, so a sorcery cannot carry it; `lose_all_abilities` strips every ability, not one keyword. The second sentence (destroy with objects {zone: battlefield, not_types: [Land], controller: any}) is expressible once the first is.
